## Work in progress

::: {.paper}

[In progress]{.stage}
[2026]{.year}
[Rotating panel · EPH, Argentina]{.source}
:::
::: {}
### Estimating the Labor Supply Effects of Argentina's 2023 Pension Moratorium
::: {.summary}
Argentina's 2023 pension moratorium (Law 27,705) allowed workers with incomplete contribution histories to access benefits by paying arrears. This paper estimates how eligibility affected labor force participation, using the staggered onset across cohorts in the EPH rotating panel.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.paper}
::: {.rail}
[In progress]{.stage}
[2026]{.year}
[Household panel · NIDS, South Africa]{.source}
:::
::: {}
### Labor Responses to Household Deaths in South Africa
::: {.summary}
Uses the National Income Dynamics Study panel to ask how surviving household members adjust labor supply following a death in the household, focusing on deaths that were plausibly unanticipated.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.paper}
::: {.rail}
[In progress]{.stage}
[2026]{.year}
[Household panel · Mexico]{.source}
:::
::: {}
### The Labor Market Effects of Repeated Drought Events in Mexico
::: {.summary}
Examines how repeated exposure to drought — as distinct from a single shock — shapes labor market outcomes in Mexico.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.paper}
::: {.rail}
[In progress]{.stage}
[2026]{.year}
[Cross-country panel · WBL, WDI]{.source}
:::
::: {}
### Sexual Harassment Legislation and Female Labor Force Participation
::: {.summary}
Asks how the adoption of sexual harassment legislation relates to female labor force participation across countries, and whether the response varies with baseline participation.
:::
:::
:::

## Reports and book chapters

- **Beyond Political Connections** (background paper), with R. Kubinec, in *Unlocking Sustainable Growth in the MENA Private Sector*, ed. R. Gatti. World Bank / EBRD / EIB, 2022.
- **Competition, Regulation, and Productivity**, with R. Divanbeigi, in *Turkey Country Economic Memorandum: Firm Productivity and Economic Growth*, ed. H. Rab. World Bank Group, 2019.
- **Suriname Investment Climate and Sector Competitiveness Report**, ed. J. Anderson. World Bank Group, 2019.
- **Firm Productivity and the Business Environment**, with M. Amin, T. Bending, A. Islam, A. Jain, and J. Rodriguez Meza, in *What's Holding Back the Private Sector in MENA?* World Bank / EBRD / EIB, 2016.
- **Jobs and Skills in the Formal Private Sector**, with M. Amin, F. Betz, A. Islam, A. Stepanov, and S. Stölting, in *What's Holding Back the Private Sector in MENA?* World Bank / EBRD / EIB, 2016.
- **Competitiveness in the MENA Region: Trade, Innovation, and Management Practices**, with H. Schweiger and A. Stepanov, in *What's Holding Back the Private Sector in MENA?* World Bank / EBRD / EIB, 2016.
- **The Effect of the Swedish Payroll Tax Cut for Youths on Firm Profitability**, with J. Eklund, N. Jiang, and A. Malm, in *Sweden's Business Climate: A Microeconomic Assessment*, ed. J. Rodriguez Meza. World Bank Group, 2016.
- **Results of the Regional Enterprise Survey in Turkey: 2016**, ed. J. Nasir. World Bank, 2016.
